name: receipts
description: Receipt management system with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:copy"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && npm run deploy:copy
scripts.heroku-postbuild: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false npm run build:all && npm run deploy:copy
